goal: Inspect each stable changed snapshot and report whether README is empty. Leave the source unchanged.

command: from pathlib import Path; p = Path('README'); print('README bytes:', p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else 'absent'); print('Inspection complete')

checks.name: review-did-not-edit
command: import subprocess; assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain']).strip(); print('Review left the snapshot clean')
